complete_issue_contract.candidate_competition: all gate-passing complete-issue matches rank by E_SP descending, p_min ascending, match_idx, match_id; deterministic top 32 candidates are searched
complete_issue_contract.gate_application: match-level E_SP floor is applied over every eligible match in the complete issue before seven-leg construction; identity GM_E_SP is then checked
complete_issue_contract.n7_construction: each candidate plus the six highest E_SP gate-passing companions from the same undivided issue; duplicate identities collapse deterministically
complete_issue_contract.no_bet: each gate×issue with no valid identity is retained explicitly as NO_BET
complete_issue_contract.overlap_accounting: every issue×gate×K participation row freezes selected identities, unique selected match count, total seven-leg positions, overlap excess legs, maximum per-match identity exposure, and the exact-ticket collision policy before outcomes
complete_issue_contract.primary_unit: (issue, fold) complete lottery issue; no selection or performance partition follows source segments
complete_issue_contract.selection_axis: each gate ranks deduplicated N7 identities by candidate rank and identity key, then freezes K=1,2,4,8 and ALL participation rows; a fixed K has explicit NO_BET if insufficient identities rather than borrowing from a segment

metrics: selector lift versus the same-gate K_ALL FULL baseline
gate×K×M interaction surface without hiding either main effect
within-issue match overlap exposure and exact-ticket collision reconciliation
hit/coverage, payout concentration, drawdown, miss streak, largest-event sensitivity
gate_b_requirements.settlement_unit: complete issue; aggregate duplicate stakes, overlap, gross return and actual tax at issue level
gate_b_requirements.sweet_spot: fixed before outcomes: relevant matched delta must persist across all three seeds and chronological fold/LOYO views; a single seed-local maximum cannot nominate policy; taxfree and taxpaid conclusions are separate. Selection-only improvement is reported even if sampler lift is absent.

market_calibration.chronology: for test year y, only outcomes with calendar year y'<y contribute; test-row outcome access is zero
market_calibration.fallback: code×handicap×bin, then code×bin, then code global; each receives fixed 50-observation shrinkage to code global hit rate before three-way renormalization
market_calibration.settlement_boundary: only aggregate historical hit counts are emitted; no match-level result_code, final SP, payout, ROI, or tax source is read into the package

outcome_boundary: No test outcome, score, final SP, winning SP, settlement, payout, ROI, tax realization, or post-kickoff market is read or emitted. Historical aggregate targets are used only for the expressly-required strictly-prior market calibration transform.

sampler_contract.M_scope: M is a per-selected-N7 ticket count. For every issue×gate×K arm, issue total draws=selected_identity_count×M and issue total stake=selected_identity_count×M×¥2; the participation grid freezes selected identity lists, FULL baselines, and shared-match exposure before outcome access.
sampler_contract.expected_unique: for each identity and M under replacement, sum_t(1-(1-w(t))^M); Gate B must compare this analytic result to realized distinct count
sampler_contract.market_p_cal: 10h EURO reciprocal-odds overround-normalized, mapped with strictly-prior calendar-year hit-rate bins and outcome-code×handicap×probability strata where n>=100
sampler_contract.q_secondary: normalize(model_p_cal * predicted_SP) per match; optional #132-derived secondary only
sampler_contract.with_replacement: independent deterministic hash draws; repeated tickets retain distinct ¥2 stakes; Gate B reports draw count and distinct-ticket count separately

scope: historical paper research only; no purchase, production, or promotion authority.
